title: Affine strict-transform chart ring
statement:
Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, let $I\subseteq A$ be an ideal, and let $a\in I$. Put $C=C_a(A,B,I)=B\otimes_A A[I/a]$ as in [def-nagata-strict-transform-basechange-chart-ring], and write $\alpha\in C$ for the image of $a$ under the structural map $A\to C$. Let

$$
T=\Gamma_{(\alpha)}(C)=\{c\in C\mid \exists n\geq0,\ \alpha^nc=0\}
$$
be the power-torsion submodule of the regular $C$-module $C$ [def-nagata-power-torsion], viewed as an ideal using [lemma-nagata-power-torsion-submodule]. Define the affine strict-transform chart ring to be the quotient ring [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]

$$
C_a^{\mathrm{st}}(A,B,I)
=C/T
=C_a(A,B,I)/\Gamma_{(a)}(C_a(A,B,I)),
$$
where the last occurrence of $a$ means its image $\alpha$ in $C$.

blueprint_notes.label: status
blueprint_notes.text:
**Status.** Bypassed by the formalized route: the strict transform is
supplied by the API of
`WeilConjectures/Compactification/StrictTransform.lean` —
`AlgebraicGeometry.strictTransform`, its closed immersion
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isClosedImmersion_pullbackLift_blowup_comap`,
and the pullback square
`AlgebraicGeometry.isPullback_strictTransformOpen` — so the
strict-transform chart rings and their cocycle are never assembled by hand.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q130-05bc18d9a (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the definition-only split in full (one commit, item and report only, no new nodes). It keeps the blueprint formula C_a^st = C_a(A,B,I)/Γ_(a)(C_a) (master order 144, main-20261015 order 152, same as blueprint_update). The added context matches the adjacent def-nagata-strict-transform-basechange-chart-ring (orders 143/151): commutative rings, I an ideal, a in I, α the image of a in C. This is no weakening, because A[S/a] = A[(S)/a]. The four stmt_deps match the citations in the text. def-nagata-power-torsion is applied with R = M = C. lemma-nagata-power-torsion-submodule makes T an ideal (its only dep is the torsion definition, so no cycle). def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient is the generic quotient, an off-unit notion, so no tool use is needed. The citers chart-closed, localization-data, chart-comparison and closed-chart-model consume the item and are not deps. A DAG search found no duplicate definition. Edge cases checked: α = 0 gives the zero ring, α a unit gives C, ℤ→ℤ/4 with a = 2 gives 0, ℤ→ℤ gives ℤ. Only split-owned fields changed versus live, and the item is still imported in live and side-live. There is no repair note and the item is not in the dropped list. Note for the maintainer: the project Lean AffineBlowup.StrictChart (StrictTransformChart.lean:60-65, no sorry) states exactly this ring and can be attached.
